name: Iron ring chandelier
description: A wrought iron ring chandelier about 1.4 m across with eight ivory candles in drip pans, four spokes to a hub with a pointed drop finial, and three chains gathering at a ring under a short hook on a round ceiling plate, 1.3 m above the finial. It hangs from the plate: lifted 2.35 m, the ring is at 2.6 m and the plate meets a ceiling at 3.65 m.

provenance.prompt: An iron ring chandelier with eight candles on three chains from a short ceiling hook, about 1.4 m across, the ring about 2.6 m above the origin on the floor.
